name: Diagrams
description: Technical fixture for the diagram content kind: Mermaid source drawn in the deck's fonts and colors. A full-slide flowchart, a sequence diagram beside text, a mind map, a timeline-family diagram, a pie diagram, a diagram with an alt, and a diagram on a dark variant.

slides.title: Every request is reviewed before it ships
slides.diagram:
flowchart LR
  A[Request] --> B{Approved?}
  B -->|yes| C[Build]
  B -->|no| D[Revise]
  D --> A
  C --> E[Test]
  E --> F{Passes?}
  F -->|yes| G[Release]
  F -->|no| C

slides.title: A rejected brief returns to its author

diagram.source:
flowchart LR
  A[Brief] --> B{Approved?}
  B -->|yes| C[Build]
  B -->|no| A
diagram.alt: A brief goes to review. Approved work is built; rejected work returns to the brief.

diagram.source:
stateDiagram-v2
  direction LR
  [*] --> Queued
  Queued --> Building
  Building --> Live: success
  Building --> Failed: error
  Failed --> Queued: retry
  Live --> [*]
diagram.alt: A deploy is queued, then built. A successful build goes live; a failed build is retried from the queue.

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: A timeless, clean, and versatile theme with balanced color contrasts and classic typography. Ideal for professional, readable presentations.

forest-green.name: Forest Green
forest-green.summary: Organic green palette for growth, health, and sustainability stories.
forest-green.description: A green and soft-neutral scheme for decks about growth, renewal, wellness, and environmental impact.

cool-horizon.name: Cool Horizon
cool-horizon.summary: Cool blue-green palette tuned for professional business decks.
cool-horizon.description: A balanced cool-toned scheme with deep navy, business blues, and teal accents. It works well across strategy, finance, and technical narratives.

aptos.name: Aptos
aptos.description: Aptos is a sans serif OPF font scheme for Latin presentations, using Aptos Display for headings with Aptos for body text.

tenorite.name: Tenorite
tenorite.description: Tenorite is a sans serif OPF font scheme for Latin presentations, using Tenorite Display for headings with Tenorite for body text.
